# Nara Charm

> Nara Charm is a heritage-inspired jewelry studio crafting bracelets, necklaces, earrings and phone charms rooted in Tibetan silverwork, Miao filigree, Han jade-tone lotus motifs, Mongolian braided cord and Thai silk traditions.

- Full machine-readable studio reference: [llms-full.txt](https://naracharm.com/llms-full.txt)

## Shop by category

- [Shop all jewelry](https://naracharm.com/shop): Browse the full 22-piece catalog by category, collection, material and price.
- [Bracelets](https://naracharm.com/collections/bracelets): Natural stone bead strands, oxidized silver amulets and adjustable braided cord bracelets ($34–$58).
- [Necklaces](https://naracharm.com/collections/necklaces): Carved celadon lotus pendants and hammered silver-and-turquoise necklaces ($96–$118).
- [Earrings](https://naracharm.com/collections/earrings): Openwork Miao-inspired silver filigree flowers and amethyst sterling silver drops ($54–$68).
- [Phone charms](https://naracharm.com/collections/phone-charms): Braided silk and natural obsidian or cinnabar-red stone charms with slim lanyard loops ($26–$32).

## Collections & craft

- [All collections](https://naracharm.com/collections): Tibetan Silver, Caravan Fusion, Han Jade, Crystal Collection, Mongolian Steppe, Southwest Filigree, Thai Silk and Cord & Stone Charms.
- [Inside the studio](https://naracharm.com/studio): Early design studies and upcoming small-batch collections.
- [Our craft](https://naracharm.com/our-craft): Material and construction notes covering wirework, braided closures and layered forms.
- [Stories](https://naracharm.com/stories): Cultural narratives behind regional silverwork, knots, jade and silk.
- [About Nara Charm](https://naracharm.com/about): Studio overview and regional craft inspirations.

## Flagship buying & material guides

- [Tibetan Silver vs 925 Sterling Silver](https://naracharm.com/blog/tibetan-silver-vs-925-sterling-silver): Composition, hallmarks, tarnishing and care comparison.
- [Natural Turquoise vs Dyed Howlite](https://naracharm.com/blog/natural-turquoise-vs-dyed-howlite-guide): How to compare veining, hardness, price and care.
- [Red Cord Bracelet Meaning & Which Wrist](https://naracharm.com/blog/red-cord-bracelet-meaning-which-wrist): Himalayan, East Asian and personal traditions plus knot care.
- [Bead Size Guide: 6 mm vs 8 mm vs 10 mm](https://naracharm.com/blog/bead-size-guide-6mm-vs-8mm-vs-10mm-bracelets): Wrist proportions, bead counts and stacking balance.
- [Meaningful Handmade Jewelry Gifts Under $100](https://naracharm.com/blog/meaningful-handmade-jewelry-gifts-under-100): Curated picks under $40, $40–$70 and $70–$100.
- [The Nara Journal](https://naracharm.com/blog): Complete library of material, fit, styling, gift and care guides.
